05 / FROM REALITY TO SIMULATION

From a real site
to a world you can test.

Create high-fidelity simulation environments with reconstruction and world models. Reuse digital assets for more efficient training and deployment.

  1. 01

    Capture the real site

    Collect LiDAR, camera and IMU data for reconstruction.

  2. 02

    3DGS / NeRF reconstruction

    Reconstruct centimeter-scale geometry and realistic textures.

  3. 03

    World-model expansion

    Vary layouts, materials, lighting and weather to create training scenarios.

  4. 04

    Physics simulation

    Use MuJoCo / PhysX for contact, dynamics and sensor simulation.

  5. 05

    Robot training & validation

    Iteratively validate reinforcement learning, task planning and inspection policies.

Reusable digital assets
  • High-fidelity scenes
  • Trainable task sets
  • Verifiable safety limits
  • An evolving data loop
